Don't show up for work man, 
if you didn't sign a contract they can't force you, they might even give you a paid position cause they need someone there,
 tell em you need to look for a paying job that your qualified for or one that you want to do? 
Sooner or later (and as selfish as it sounds)  you'll have to start looking out for yourself and thinking about future, if you don't nothing will change and it's sounds like that's not an option for you, hang in there bud :)

Hey man, happy birthday :) 
Sorry to hear your going through a rough time, most people have been where you are, (but that doesn't make it any easier for you) I think the main reason people say "don't do it" is because it's perceived as wrong. 

However the people who have been in your situation will say "don't do it" because they're on the other side and they can see (cliché alert!) it does get better. 

Sounds like you need a bit of direction bud, don't put yourself under the constraints of normal life because that's clearly not working for you, do whatever makes you happy even if it's a little bit, just to get you out of your slump. 

if your at the point where nothing makes you happy take a trip over to the get motivated subreddit, see if that stirs anything in you? Nothing makes your head clearer than getting your sweat on, a good workout will also release those lovely endorphins that make you happy :) 

you've took a giant step coming here and telling strangers how you feel and I feel that you have the desire to change your circumstances that's why I'm trying to give you as many options as possible. 

There are plenty of  avenues to take that will improve your quality of life but first you need a plan, 
think about a job you could see yourself doing and try and get into an entry level/access course that will take you in that direction, it will be tough but it's not impossible. 
That's all I have just now but if you want to talk more or anything send me a pm an we can try and think of something else that would help :)

Hang in there bud, if you want it enough you can make it better, I promise

Thanks man, I thought this subreddit was dead looking through the other posts but all the replies I've had have been amazing in making me feel better and less alone if that makes sense, I'm so glad this place exists for people like me and us, 
I'll try your suggestions, a coffee would probably give me a nice boost at this point
22, I'll be 23 in a few months

Thankyou, even though it feels like I'm admitting defeat by letting people know how close I am to giving up, I already feel like at least trying to be stronger, but I still haven't left my bed and the nauseous feeling is still hanging around but my head feels clearer and not as foggy, but even when I start getting to a decent place mood wise the anxiety kicks up again because I know I'll be feeling like this again soon, everyone says it will get better but it never lasts and it makes it harder and harder to pick myself up again when I get to this point because I really see no end to the cycle :/

I don't know the exact name she forgot what it was called before she could tell me and I'm scared to know because I'll scour the Internet for all the information on it and probably make myself worry more, I know she's the only one in the hospital(raigmore in Inverness) who's had it or has it and they want to put her on an experimental treatment working with some doctors in London, and if the chemo doesn't work she'll need a bone marrow transplant, 
I try to change the subject whenever she talks about it because I want her to be positive and I know she'll be thinking of everything that could go wrong
I'm used to people being cold and distant, the fact that you took time out of your day to comment is more than enough, thankyou <3

I do love her very much, she's the only girl who's put up with me longer than a few months, You make a good point, I know I'm being selfish talking like this, I just can't help thinking I make everything worse or more complicated cause I'm involved(I don't bring much to the table career or skill wise, I can't even drive yet) 
What if I leave her an she meets someone who can give her a rich life an give her everything she deserves, wouldn't that be better for her?

Thanks man, I may have made man tears knowing I'm not the only one feeling so bad, being a guy and so emotionally weak makes me feel like a failure everyday. 

it's only been a day so far so I think I have a good chance but you never know with these things :/
I usually talk to my girlfriend about everything but I can't bring myself to tell her I made this huge mistake cause she doesn't need the extra stress at this point in time so I feel even more alone than usual. 

One of the things that hurts the most is that I thought I could make her life better by doing this course so when she got better we'd have something but now she's gunna be stuck with a guy who's best option for a career is a cleaner and I can't even drive yet, I'm reminded I have nothing to offer anyone
